scope: Literal exact-dyadic reference and approximate fixed-grid replay of two-bank unitary-endpoint recursive words. Canonical C cases and explicit nonlinear-conjugate unitary cases have uniform local bank shears and decreasing child widths. Complete arbitrary dirty Gaussian fields, exact inverse endpoints, scalar rounding, magnitude guards and charged padded-bank projection are tested. No native time, paid layout, faster bulk supplier, exact outer integer recovery or exponent is supplied.
